purpose: Customer-content consumption contract for canonical product copy, source-owned facts, OpenLab evidence and runtime-owned commerce state. Route patterns are matchers for design and implementation planning; they are not executable redirects.

interpretation: 31 is the historical exact four-width candidate subset recorded by CONV-003/CONV-004; it is not the current route inventory.
52 is the current exact CUSTOMER_ROUTES review and proof registry in site-route-data.mjs.
68 is the current count of physical Next.js page patterns: 39 exact core paths plus 29 declared dynamic, frontier or owner patterns.
73 is the canonical ledger disposition and pattern count, including query and pattern dispositions that are not all physical pages.
19 is the CANDIDATE-STANDALONE registry count outside the canonical ledger, including the physically implemented but DESIGN_INCOMPLETE and NOT_PROMOTED /bundle-builder.
This matrix groups consuming surfaces and does not claim to add rows to, remove rows from or replace any of those inventories.

aliasPolicy.rule: Aliases may be recorded for reconciliation and content lookup only. This contract must not create, imply or configure an executable redirect.

responsiveProofContract.law: Every adopted route family must preserve source meaning, content order, readable wrapping, focus access and intentional omission at all four registered widths. A desktop-only pass is insufficient.

dataOwner.composition: Sites with Figma as inspection mirror

rows.audience: new and returning commercial visitors
rows.desktopBehavior: Full identity, short thesis, governed hero render, source-ready metrics, evidence status and runtime commerce decision surface.
rows.mobileBehavior: Summary order: identity, short thesis, render, source-ready metrics, evidence status, then runtime commerce action; no automatic claim truncation.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Omit thesis or metrics that are not CONTENT_READY, keep a governed empty media chamber when no approved render exists, show evidence unavailable only from the evidence contract, and omit commerce until the runtime projection resolves.

rows.audience: commercial browsers comparing entry products
rows.desktopBehavior: Featured and vertical cards may expose short copy and a metric subset; compact cards prioritize identity, render and route action.
rows.mobileBehavior: Single-column or sanctioned horizontal carousel with identity first, concise CONTENT_READY summary and 44px actions.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Use an unpopulated chamber for missing media, omit unready narrative and facts, and use explicit unavailable states without substituting another product.
forbidden: universal TESTED or THIRD PARTY chips

dataOwner.taxonomy: Woo category and tag ledger plus owner-locked form and quantity projection
dataOwner.identity: canonical content registry resolved to Woo product ID

rows.audience: customers browsing, filtering or searching the range
rows.desktopBehavior: Persistent discovery controls beside or above a multi-column grid; card facts remain consistent with the PDP source record.
rows.mobileBehavior: Filters collapse or reorder above a single-column/compact grid; empty results retain the current query without inventing a zero-result authority state.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Unknown filters are ignored per the taxonomy contract, missing card facts are omitted, and ambiguous identity removes the product from the commerce projection until resolved.
allowed: independent family, goal, form, servings and availability dimensions
OR within a dimension and AND across dimensions
forbidden: deriving form or servings from Woo prose

rows.module: PDP hero and first-fold purchase decision
rows.audience: customers making a product decision
rows.desktopBehavior: Media and purchase plane remain distinct; identity, factual metric rail, evidence status and runtime commerce form the decision sequence.
rows.mobileBehavior: Reorder to product identity and media before a compact decision summary; the mobile summary mirrors the same runtime price and availability projection rather than a separate fixture.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Keep media chamber empty when unbound, render em dash only in stable metric anatomy, omit unready thesis, present evidence unavailable from OpenLab, and suppress purchase action if commerce is unresolved.

rows.audience: detail-oriented customers reviewing exact product format
rows.desktopBehavior: Facts, product visual and composition remain separately labelled dossier regions; medium/long copy follows the factual panels.
rows.mobileBehavior: Progressive disclosure with facts first; composition and long copy collapse without changing labels or values.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Omit absent composition rows, preserve an explicit unavailable fact value only where the component anatomy requires it, and never fill from a related product or editorial prose.
allowed: label claim clearly labelled as a label claim
forbidden: static interactive-tab claims when the surface is non-interactive

rows.module: PDP evidence snapshot and dossier evidence link

dataOwner.analyticalValuesAndStatus: OpenLab public projection backed by the named laboratory record

rows.audience: customers seeking record-specific product evidence
rows.desktopBehavior: Display a compact source-connected record summary with direct OpenLab and original-source actions when available.
rows.mobileBehavior: Show evidence status and named-record summary before collapsed record detail; retain accessible table equivalents for analytical visuals.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Render the explicit unavailable or partial evidence boundary; do not show a record CTA, analytical value or verified label without an applicable record binding.
allowed: named lab, batch, report and date
label-to-report comparison when both sides are bound

rows.audience: customers comparing a legitimate next product decision
rows.desktopBehavior: Related cards retain source facts and a separately approved relationship rationale; rail does not alter the anchor product decision.
rows.mobileBehavior: Sanctioned horizontal carousel with 44px actions and no hidden factual differences.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Omit an unapproved relationship edge; never synthesize STACKS WELL WITH from a related-product array alone.
allowed: typed COMPLEMENT, ALTERNATIVE, COMPARE or CONTINUATION edge

rows.module: OpenLab portal, wayfinding and record archive
rows.audience: customers browsing the evidence register
rows.desktopBehavior: Portal introduction, record search/browse controls and source-owned register summaries remain distinct from product marketing.
rows.mobileBehavior: Reorder portal content, summarize archive rows and allow sanctioned horizontal scrolling only for record tables.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Show no-results or unavailable state without did-you-mean substitution; omit global metrics unless the current OpenLab projection supplies their exact semantic basis.
allowed: OpenLab-owned record counts and aggregates with basis

rows.audience: customers connecting one product to its available evidence
rows.desktopBehavior: Record, history, label comparison, analytes and source context are explicit views backed by one product projection.
rows.mobileBehavior: Summary then progressive disclosure with keyboard-reachable controls, static-data motion policy and table equivalents.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Use partial or unavailable product experience; no cloned MK-2866 data and no enabled source action without a bound record.

dataOwner.recordIdentityAndValues: OpenLab public projection and named source report

rows.audience: customers inspecting a named record or batch
rows.desktopBehavior: Present record identity before analytes, chronology and source action; tables remain exact source projections.
rows.mobileBehavior: Reorder identity and summary ahead of horizontally scrollable technical tables with keyboard reachability.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Show UnavailableEvidencePanel with no fallback result, no replacement record and no source-generation claim.
forbidden: claiming a provider file is present without the OpenLab source action

rows.module: OpenLab CoA and evidence document viewer
rows.audience: customers opening a source-connected evidence document
rows.desktopBehavior: Document identity, source action and table/text alternative remain visible around the viewer.
rows.mobileBehavior: Summary-first document identity with an explicit external source action; document table may use sanctioned horizontal scroll.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Render document unavailable; do not display a viewer, filename, provider-status message or download action without a bound source document.
forbidden: live fetch in the presentation candidate

rows.audience: customers assembling a non-prescriptive product bundle
rows.desktopBehavior: Selection cards and bundle summary remain separate; facts and commerce values are sourced per product.
rows.mobileBehavior: Collapse selection groups into a linear flow with a sticky summary only after runtime commerce resolves.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Disable selection for unresolved commerce or identity; omit unsupported rationale and evidence instead of substituting generic benefit language.
forbidden: claiming this candidate path is a new canonical ledger route

rows.audience: customers comparing product roles without personal regimen advice
rows.desktopBehavior: Goal context controls which approved relationship edges are shown; each card keeps product facts, rationale, evidence and commerce separate.
rows.mobileBehavior: Sanctioned carousel for product cards and collapsed outcome summary; selection state remains keyboard and touch accessible.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Hide relationship choices lacking CONTENT_READY rationale; an unavailable evidence state remains visible and does not block factual comparison unless the edge requires evidence.

rows.audience: customers comparing exact product formats or evidence paths
rows.desktopBehavior: Align equivalent source fields in columns and keep label claims visually distinct from analytical results.
rows.mobileBehavior: Sanctioned horizontal scroll with sticky product identity and accessible table semantics.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Render an em dash or unavailable state in the affected cell; do not rank, impute or normalize missing facts.

rows.audience: customers at explicitly sanctioned continuation points
rows.desktopBehavior: Recommendations and restock remain distinct views; rationale is visible and product cards retain canonical source data.
rows.mobileBehavior: Collapse the rail or use the registered card carousel; no hidden auto-add action.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Omit the recommendation when rationale, identity or commerce binding is unavailable; do not fall back to a generic bestseller.
forbidden: use on payment, processing, order-pay, failure or retry

dataOwner.evidenceMethodology: approved OpenLab methodology and source-chain content

rows.audience: customers learning how to read product and evidence information
rows.desktopBehavior: Long-form explanatory sections may link to named records and methodology without inserting product commerce.
rows.mobileBehavior: Summary then progressive disclosure; definitions remain adjacent to the technical term they explain.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Use source-checking or unavailable copy only when that wording is CONTENT_READY; otherwise omit the incomplete educational module.

dataOwner.policyAnswers: applicable support or commerce policy owner

rows.audience: customers seeking product, evidence or service help
rows.desktopBehavior: Questions are grouped by subject and may deep-link to the exact product, policy or record source.
rows.mobileBehavior: Collapsed question list with one answer expanded at a time and 44px summary controls.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Omit an unapproved answer and route the customer to general contact support; do not improvise policy, delivery or product guidance.

rows.module: bag line-item product identity and sanctioned continuation

dataOwner.lineIdentity: canonical product registry resolved against cart/order state
dataOwner.composition: Shopper runtime adopting Sites contract later

rows.audience: customers reviewing selected items before checkout
rows.desktopBehavior: Line items show exact product identity, format, quantity and runtime monetary state; any continuation rail is visually and semantically separate.
rows.mobileBehavior: Compact line identity with quantity and total prioritized; continuation collapses below the bag summary.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Preserve order/cart identity from its owner projection, omit optional static facts and media, and suppress continuation if its relationship is not CONTENT_READY.
forbidden: evidence status unrelated to the line

dataOwner.lineIdentityAndSelection: C2/Woo checkout projection joined to canonical identity
dataOwner.composition: Shopper checkout runtime adopting Sites contract later

rows.audience: customers confirming which product is in the order
rows.desktopBehavior: Order summary may show name, alias, selected format and small render only; transaction values stay with the checkout projection.
rows.mobileBehavior: Collapsed order summary preserves exact product name and selected format; no promotional expansion.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Use the checkout/order owner identity; omit optional alias or render if registry binding is unavailable and never block payment on optional content.
allowed: transaction values from the transaction owner

dataOwner.continuation: approved relationship graph plus current commerce projection
dataOwner.composition: Shopper account/post-purchase runtime adopting Sites contract later

rows.audience: customers reviewing a completed order or returning to their account
rows.desktopBehavior: Order identity remains primary; a separately labelled continuation module may appear only after successful confirmation or in the account context.
rows.mobileBehavior: Order identity first; continuation collapses below the order result and must not obscure status or support actions.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Order identity remains from the order owner; omit continuation entirely if rationale or commerce state is unavailable.
allowed: account restock presentation when owner data exists
forbidden: continuation on pending, failed or cancelled result

rows.audience: customers completing, waiting for or recovering a transaction
rows.desktopBehavior: No product marketing, evidence promotion, recommendation, bundle or continuation module; only transaction-owner order identity where required to identify the payment.
rows.mobileBehavior: Same silence contract; transaction status, recovery action and support remain the only priorities.
rows.missingContentBehavior: Not applicable: product-content absence is intentional and must not trigger a fallback module.
allowed: minimal order or line identity supplied by the transaction owner
retry or support action owned by the transaction surface
forbidden: product facts beyond necessary order identity
